parsed.rationale: Four separate `extension` declarations on `String` are spread across three distinct packages (`Playlist`, `AnalyticsMacros`, `Analytics`) with no restraint markers on any record. The most pragmatic consolidation would be to audit whether any of the helpers (e.g., the HTML-decoding utilities in `String+HTMLDecoding.swift`) are general enough to live in a shared foundation package that all three consumers already depend on, and to eliminate the ad-hoc per-file extensions in `FlowsheetEntryType.swift` (line 106), `AnalyticsEventMacro.swift` (line 154), and `AnalyticsEvent.swift` (line 39) if they duplicate that functionality. At minimum, the `Playlist`-internal extension at line 106 of `FlowsheetEntryType.swift` should be moved into `String+HTMLDecoding.swift` to keep all `String` extensions within `Playlist` in one place.
